name: Shadow Demon

actions.name: Shadow Claws
actions.effect: This damage bypasses physical resistance and armor.

actions.name: Shadow Pounce
actions.effect: The demon leaps from one shadow to another within 12m and attacks. If the target didn't see the demon before the attack, the target has -1d6 to defense.

reactions.name: Meld with Shadow
reactions.effect: When targeted by an attack while in dim light or darkness, the demon merges with shadows. The attack has -2d6 to hit.

traits.name: Incorporeal in Darkness
traits.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the Shadow Demon is incorporeal and can move through objects and creatures.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.desc: In bright light, the Shadow Demon has -1d6 to attack rolls and loses its incorporeal ability.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: In dim light or darkness, the Shadow Demon is invisible.

lore: Shadow Demons are demons stripped of their physical form, existing as malevolent shadows. They lurk in dark places, possessing the weak-willed and attacking from the darkness. Bright light is their bane, forcing them into a vulnerable corporeal state.
